m.e: Uh, these inhumans are not our enemies.

m.t: Ne každý vidí a cítí věci stejně jako ostatní.
m.e: Not everyone in life sees and feels things exactly the same as others.

m.e: I know you're trying to protect your parents, but she can see you're doing that.

m.e: The one who sees all and knows all is asking us to see see nothing and know nothing.

m.t: Uvědomuješ si, že ochranka vidí všechno, že jo?
